text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Dai hpang Whirling Dervishes hpung ni gaw pyinra ntsa shara la mat ai.
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu gaw Italy Alessandro Safina hte Greek kaw na yung ngoi ning hkring Haris Alexiou hpe hkrang shala ai.
text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Shangut shakre na matu, Anatolia a wan ngu mying ai Turkish ka uhpung ni gaw "Troy" madun dan ai lam hpe hkrang shala lai wa sai re.
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, asak 13 re ai sengke shingjawng ai wa gaw Indianapolis sengke jawn lam kaw adawt hkrum ai kaw lawm nna si mat ai.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Shi sai shalum ginsup taw ai laman e Lenz gaw shi a lagaw leng ntsa kaw na di hkrat mat ai, ngut na shi hte arau shingjawng ai wa Xavier Zayat hte adawt hkrup ai.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Shi gaw kalang ta lam ntsa na tsi magam gun e gawn lajang ai lam hkrum nna, hpang e shi si mat ai shara, buga tsi rung de htaw sa da hkrum ai re.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Ndai mabyin hta Zayat gaw hkala nba nhkrum lai wa ai re.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Mungkan ting a sut masa hpe mahta nna Zapatero matut tsun ai gaw "sut gumhpraw hte seng ai gawda hkrang gaw sut lu nga mai lam a ahkyak dik ai daw langai mi rai nga ai.
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Anhte hta shaning tup na ja gumhpraw ginchyum chyat mat wa ai, lai wa sai shata lahkawng hta gaw grau nna laja lana sawng mat ai, dai hpang de she ngai shadu ai, ja gumhpraw gat lawk ni bai kaja hpang wa ai."
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Lai sai bat hta Naked Shiga dap kaw na shanhte gaw gau ngwi ngwi hte shanhte a shi shana dap nnan masum hte rau shiga ni hpe mungkan ga gada hte seng ai aga ni hte shapoi sa na matu masing jahkrat masat sa wa mai ai lam ndau shana dat ai.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: English hte Japan hku gaw mi kaw na shiga shapoi taw sai re nna mungkan ting hte seng ai uhpung uhpawng ni gaw Spain ga, Italy ga, Korea ga lamang ni hpe hkrangmu shiga, internet laika man ni hte gun hkawm mai ai jak ni a matu shabra hpang taw sai re.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Gam kaja ai majaw ngai kaw hpa nbyin ai, raitim si mat sai masha ni wa shinggan de lu le na matu hku wawt ni hpe adup ga taw ai lam hpe shingran pra pra mu ai.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Masha ni gaw hkuwawt pat maka hpe lahkum hte gayet ma timung hkuwawt chyinghka ni gaw daw hten ai lam nnga ai.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: "Hpang jahtum hta pat langai ga mat nna shanhte ni gaw hku wawt kaw nna le hpang wa masai," ngu nna asak lawt wa ai Franciszek Kowal tsun lai wa ai re.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Hydrogen atom ni gaw grai li ai nhprang jet ni hpe hkrang shapraw na matu rau sha majaw (sh gahkying) mat ai shaloi shagan ni gaw tsam n-gun na majaw nhtoi hte kahtet ai hpe shapru ai.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Hpungtang hpaji ninghkring ni gaw tsam n-gun hpe bung ai lam hku na lu galaw ai nuclear bunghkrawng langai hpe shapraw na matu galaw taw nga ma ai.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Kaning rai timung, ndai manghkang gaw loi loi hte hparan mai ai manghkang nrai nga ai. Kaja nan akyu rawng ai shingja dat kabaw bunghkrawng hpe mu lu na matu gaw shaning loi naw na na re.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Dai hpri sumri gaw hka ntsa kaw nga taw ai re hpa majaw nga yang hka gaw lagi ja taw na re.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Hka ntsa man na hka molecule ni a majaw ntsa man ja dingkang lam byin ai gaw de lahta na nbung molecule ni hta langai hte langai ngang ngang matut da ai lam a majaw re.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Hka bungshi ni gaw samit zawn re arai ni hpe hka ntsa waw taw shangun lu ai baw hka ntsa man kaw na nmu lu ai hpyi ni hpe galaw ya ai re.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Ya prat na hkyen pa din hkyepdin ni a ningshang hta nten lahkawng lawm nna, shanhte a ka'ang hta e hku zawn re lawm chye ai. Ndai nten lahkawng gaw hkyen pa ntsa e ding yau mat yang pi n galau hkra magra da ya lu ai.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Nhtu a htum pa maga gaw magaw taw ai majaw, nhtu a lahkawng yan maga nchyan de, ndung gaw hkyen hte hkra taw ai majaw magaw taw nga ai.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Ndai a majaw leng jawn ai wa gayin mat ai re. Lama na leng jawn ai wa gaw lahkra maga she gayin yang gaw hkra maga de sa mat na re, lama na lapai maga de gayin ai rai yang pai maga de yawng mat na re.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Kaja ai ngun level bai lu na matu shanhte gaw wan kaw na lu ai jan taw ai ngun ni hpe shayen kau ra na re.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Dai hpe shanhte gaw sumla ngu ai wan kaw na kaji ai ayun ya ni hpe shapraw nna galaw wa ai.
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Hpaji rawng ni gaw dai lam hpe radio shapraw na matu ngun jaw ai ngut shaga ma ai hpamajaw nga yang atom ni hpe wan ni kaw na ngun kaw ai, wan na photon shapraw ai hpe byin shangun ai majaw re ngut nna wan gaw radio myu mi re.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Dai laga sumla gaw atom shapraw ai lam hpe madun ai re. kaja nang yang, photon ni gaw dai kaw madun da ai hta grau kaji ai re.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Photo ni gaw atom hpe galaw ai ri ni hta grau kaji ai re.
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Hking latsa hku bungli galaw ngut ai hpang wan pu kaw na wan sumri ni gaw hkru wa ai ngut nna wan pu mung bungli ngalaw mat sai.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Ndai wan pu hpe galai kau ai lam galaw ya ra sai. Wan pu galai ai shaloi sadi sahka ai la gaw ahkyak la nga ai.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Shawng nnan, wan hkalok hpe byeng mayu yang wan shawng sat kau u dai nrai wan sumri hpe shawng dik kau u.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Dai gaw wan ngun gaw wan pu kaw na gumhpaw de sa wa nna wan ngu hpe jaw ai majaw re nang dai socket kata kaw na gumhpraw hpe sa jum yang dai kaw wan ngun naw nga taw na re.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Hkum kaw na sai hpe gayin ya ai gaw salum re, shi gaw dsai hpe tu ya ai re.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Salum kaw na tube kata sai hkawm mat ai hpe sai dat lasa ngu tsun nna tube kata hku salum de bai wa ai hpe sai ginhtan lasa ngu tsun ai. Grai kaja ai tube ni hpe gaw kara zawn grai kaji ai sai lam ni ngu ai.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Triceratop a wa gaw namlap sha nre hpun hte aru ni hpe ma dang gawa ai re.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Hpungtang hpaji ninghkring ni gaw cycads ngu mying ai Cretaceous kaw mu mada lu ai hpun ni hpe Triceratop ni sha ma ai ngu shadu ma ai.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Ndai hpun ni gaw lap masen ai, jan mau hkrang zawn re namhtan hpun kaji zawn san ai.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Triceratop ni gaw dai hpun mat hpe nsha shi yang alap ni hpe shi ngup masen hte yeng kau lu ai.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Kaga hpungtang hpaji ninghkring ni dang rang ai lam gaw ndai hpun ni gaw gung grai rawng ai baw rai nga ai, dai majaw ndai prat hta na sangang ni hte hkai ke (moi prat na dusat ni kaw na yu hkrat wa ai) zawn re ai kaga dusat ni gung rawng ai namlap namsi ni hpe sha ai raitim pyi moi prat na dusat ni shanhte hpe sha lai wa ai lam gaw nau nmai byin na re.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Lo a ginding aga gang n-gun gara hku na ngai hpe gang da ai kun? Lama nang lo ntsa man hta tsap yang, Mungkan ga kaw nga ai hta joi si grai tsang na ra ai.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Mungkan ga kaw pound 200 (90kg) li ai masha gaw lo kaw pound 36 (16kg) sha li ai. Dai majaw ginding ga n-gun nang hpe nau n-gang da lu ai.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Jan kaw gaw mungkan ga kaw na jawn nang mai tsap ai ntsa lam n-nga ai. Jan yawng hpe gaw dat nsa, wan hte dat yi la n-gun bung ai dat nsa ni rau galaw da ai re.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Dat nsa gaw Jan ka'ang kaw na tsan magang grau hpa wa magang re.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Jan hpe yu ai shaloi mu lu ai shinggan maga daw hpe gaw nhtoi shing "photosphere", nga ma ai. Nhtoi bawlung ngu mung lachyum mai shapraw nga ai.
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Shaning hkying masum na ai shaloi, 1610 ning hta, Itali amyu sha lamu shagan hpaji ninghkring wa Galileo Galilei gaw shata zawn sha Venus mung rawt jat taw ai lam hpe sumtsan yu myiset lang nna maram yu ai.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Byin yan ni gaw byin ai hpa majaw nga yang Venus (sh Shata) a maga mi de sha Jan htoi nga ai hpe man hkrum ai. Venus a byin yan ni gaw gintawng ni gaw Jan hpe shinggrup ai ngu ai Copernicus a myit ningmu hpe wa madi shadaw da ai.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Bai shaning kachyi myi na mat ai hpang shaning 1639 kaw, Jeremiah Horrocks mying ai Englik hpungtang lamu hkam jak gawt masha gaw Venus a lai sa ai lam hpe bai mu sagawn la lu ai.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: England gaw Dane ni uphkang ai upadi e bai padang dip la ngut ai kaw na sim sa ai aten galu hpe hkrum sha lai wa sai re.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Kaning rai nme law, 991 ning hta Ethelred gaw lai wa sai Guthrum a shaning ladaw shaloi na hta grau kaba ai panglai damya ni hte hkrum hkra wa ai.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Ndai chyang lawa ai hpung hpe Olaf Trygvasson kaw na woi awn ai, yaw shada lam kaba ai Norwegian wa gaw Danish ka'up tawn ai kaw na shi mungdan hpe bai hpyi la na matu re.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Shawng na hpyen dap hpang de htingnut mat ai hpang Ethelred gaw Norway mungdan de bai wa nna shi a hkawhkam mungdan hpe lapran madang awng dang lam hte bai lu la na matu shakut taw nga ai Olaf hte myit hkrum lu ai.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul gaw mying gumhkawng ai shani shagu jai lang ai hta yaw shada nna gyin shalat da ai laika kanu re. Dai laika kanu hpe gaw hkawhkam Sejong uphkang ai shaning (1418-1450) lamang, shaning 1444 hta gyin shalat lai wa sai re.
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Sejong hkawhkam gaw Joseon hkaw dung ladaw a mali lang na hkawhkawm rai nna na chying hkungga ging ai hkawhkam langai rai nga ai.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Hangeul laika kanu hpe Hunmin Jeongeum ngu nna mying jaw dat ai, lachyum gaw "masha ni a matsun madun lam a matu jaw ai nsen ni" rai nga ai.
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Sanskrit gara hku nga nga wa ai lam hte seng nna myit jasat ai lam grai law wa myi nga ai. Shanhte kaw na langai myi gaw, sinna kaw na India de shanhte a a-ga ni hpe la wa ai Aryan buhkawmg htawtsit hpung langai a lam rai nga ai.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskrit gaw moi na aga langai re nna dai hpe Uropa a Latin aga hte mai shingdaw yu ai.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Mungkan hta jau dik htum ai ngu chye lu ai laika buk hpe Sanskrit hku ka da ai re. Upanishad rau pawng ngut ai hpang kaw na gaw, aya nem tsaw madang hkan ai masa a majaw Sanskrit gaw hkoi mat lai wa ai re.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskrit ga gaw prat dep Kala ga hpan law law a npawt mahta ai ga, ga si grai law ai hte hkum ai a ga langai re, French hte Spanish ga zawn sha Uropa dan a ga hpan npawt madung re nga ai Latin ga zawn sha re.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Germani mungdan gaw France mungdan hte majan kasat ngut ai hpang Britain mungdan a zunlawng de hpyen n-gun hte shang na matu shajin ma ai.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Germany ni gaw dai hpe Operation Sealion ngu shamying ma ai. Dia hpe Dunkirk kaw na yen kau ai shaloi British hpyen dap na lengnak kaba ni law malawng hten mat ai, dai majaw dai hpyen dap ni gaw chyi mi ngun yawm mat ai.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Raitim Hkawhkam amyu a Hka dap gaw German hka dap ("Kriegsmarine") hta grau n-gun ja ai majaw Inglik maga de shana nna shang gasat na matu nmai byin chye ai.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Kaning nga tim, shanhte a ningbaw ni gaw German ni a pyenli hte htim gasat na hpe hkrit ai majaw, Hkawhkam Amyu Hka dap sanghpaw ni hpe hpyen htim mai ai lam kaw loi mi shada da ma ai.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Italy a masing ni hpe sanglang dan ai lam kaw na shawng hpang wa ga. Italy gaw Germany hte Japan a madung hku na "kanau kaji" rai lai wa sai.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Shanhte ni majan hpang ai hte sanghpaw nnan mali gaw shachyaw ngut ai rai tim shanhte kaw grau n-gun nrawng ai hpyen dap hte hka dap hpe lu lai wa sai.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Italy ni a awngdan ai lam gaw African mungdan ni kaw re. dai mungdan ni hpe shanhte gaw masha law law hte Mediterranean panglai hpe lai nna Africa hpe aup hkang na re.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: De a matu, shanhte gaw British sanghpaw ni, daru ni hpe Egutu kaw na shapraw kau ra na. Dai hku hkrang shapraw ai hta, Itali a hpyen sanghpaw ni hpe hpa nan nmai galaw ai.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Ya na Japan mung gaw panglai kata na Britain zawn re ai zinlawng mungdan kaji langai re.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Hka npu kaw chye hkawm ai sanghpaw ni gaw hka kata hkawm na matu shapraw da ai sanghpaw ni re, ngut na ngam ai aten ni hta gaw dai kaw nga nga na matu re.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Hka shang sanghpaw ni hpe Mungkan Majan I hte II hta lang ma ai. Dai ten ni hta dai ni gaw grai naw lanyan nna tsan de gap shading ai lam mung shadawn sharam de naw re.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Majan shawng maga de gaw shanhte ni panglai ntsa hku sha malawng hkrun lam hkawm ai, raitim radar hpe gin shalat hpang wa ai hte grau tup hkrak byin wa ai hte gaw hka shang sanghpaw ni hpe hka kata nmu lu shangun mayu ai majaw lang shaja wa ma ai.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Germany ni a hka npu kaw hkawm ai sanghpaw ni hpe gaw U-Sanghpaw ni ngu nna shaga lai wa sai re. Germany masha ni gaw hka lam hkawm sa ai lam hte shanhte na hka shang sanghpaw hte hpyen gasat ai lam hta grai kung kyang lai wa ai re.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Hka shang sanghpaw hte awngdang lam lu la ai majaw, majan ngut ai hpang Germani ni hpe grai naw nga na re ngu nkam ma ai.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Rai sa! Hkaw hkam Tutankhamun hpe kalang lang hkaw hkam Tut dai nrai hkaw hkam kasha ngut tsun dan ma ai, shi gaw ya prat hta ram ram chye ai Egypt hkaw hkam ni kaw na langai re.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Myit shang sha hpa gaw shi hpe moi prat na aten hta grai ahkyak ai masha hku nsawn la hkrum nna moi prat na hkaw hkam jahpan hta mung n-matsing da hkrum nga ai.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Hpa mi raitim 1922 hta shi a lup hpe mu sawk tam ai gaw shi hpe masha law law hpe chye wa shangun ai. Lup law law hpe lagu la nga ai laman ndai lup gaw dingbai dingna nnga ai sha ngam taw nga ai.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Manu dan ai gyu ni hte lung seng ni hte galaw da ai masha lang rung rai hkying hku lawm ai rai law malawng hpe Tutankhamun hta atsawm lup makoi da ai.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Spoke dingsen leng byin shalat ai Assyrian leng gaw grau tsang hkra, grau lawan hkra hpyen ni hpe atsawm shingle kau hkra hte kaga hpyen leng ni hta grau kaja hkra byin shalat da ai.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Hkrit na zawn re ai ndan pala ni gaw hpyen wa a n-gang palawng kata du hkra lu shang ai re. 1000 B.C ram hta Assyrian ni gaw shawng na ndan sinat hpe madun lai wa sai re.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Gumra dap ni gaw gumra hte hpyen kasat na matu re. Gumra hking hpe gin shalat ai lam rai nnga shi ai. Dai majaw Assyrian gumra dap ni gaw gumra ntsa hpa nlawm ai dai hku dung nna gasat ma ai.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Anhte gaw Greek mung masa la ni, hpungtang hpaji ninghkring ni hte shingni masha law law hpe chye ai. Ndai ni kaw na chye dik masha gaw Homer,Greek laili laika hta reng dik ai ga shagawp lahkawng: Iliad hte Odyssey hpe shagawp da ai mying gumhkawng ai myi nmu ga shagawp sara re.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocle ni hte Aristophane ni gaw mying naw gumhkawng nga ai kamung naura ka sara ni rai nna shanhte a kamung naura ni gaw mungkan laika a hkik hkam htum ai lata bungli ni ngu na sawn la hkrum ma ai.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Kaga mying gumhkawng ai Greek masha langai mi gaw shi a mying gumhkawng ai man masum jut a la hkra maga man ni matut mahkai ai lam ni hte seng nna shaleng dan ai gashawn ni a majaw law malawng e chye lai wa ai sawn hpan hpaji ninghking Pythagoras re nga ai.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Masha kade ram wa mi Hindi ga hpe amyu myu hku shaga ai ngu ai hku tau sawn yu ai lam ni nga ai re. Ndai gaw mungkan hta nambat lahawng hte nambat mali law htum law malawng shaga hkrum ai ga hpan re ai ngu tau sawn da hkrum lai wa sai re.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Jauman ga shaga ai masha jahpan ni gaw buga ginra ga ni htep ai hta hkan nna shai mat wa ai.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Sawn yu ai daram, ga shaga ai marai wan 340 kaw na wan 500 lapran hte wan 800 daram gaw tsun shaga ga hpe chye na ma ai.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi hte Urdu gaw ga bungai raitim laika nbung ai; ga shagu, shaga ai lahkang yang shada da chye na ma ai.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Tsa ban 15th daram hta, Estonia dingdung gaw Germany a htunghking grai nan ka'up da ai ten re.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Nkau Germany hpunggyi ni gaw Karai Kasang hpe masha ni hte grau ni htep hkra la wa mayu ma ai, dai majaw shanhte gaw Estonian laika hpe galaw shapraw lai wa ai re.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Dai hpe German laika kanu kaw na la da ai re ngut nna "Õ/õ" hpe kahtap bang da ai re.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Aten ni lai wa sai zawn, German kaw na la da ai ga ni yawng gayau wa sai. Dai gaw chye wa ai a ningpawt re.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Jawng ngut ai hpang hkaw hkam aya hpe hpyen dap de shap da na re.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Raitim, Charles gaw Cambridge kaw na Trinity dakkasu hta Anthropology hte Archaeology hpe sharing wa sai, ngut nna hpang de labau, 2:2 (madang nem ai jam mau) hpe lu wa ai.
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Hkaw hkam kasha Charles gaw British hkawhkam nta masha ni kaw na shawng nnan jam mau gup lu ai wa rai nga ai.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Europa na Turkey (Balkan zundawn na sinpraw Thrace Rumelia) gaw mungdan a 3% lawm ai.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Turkey madu ai ginwang ni gaw 1,600 kilometers (1,000 mi) galu nna 800 km (500 mi) hta grau dam nga nna rectangular hkrang zawn rai nga ai.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Nawng ni ma lawm, Turkey mungdan a shara gaw, 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi) kaba ai re nna, 755,562 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) gaw Asia dan a dingda sinna maga re nhktawm 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) gaw Europe maga hkran de re.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Turkey shara gaw mungkan hta 37th kaba dik re, ngut nna dai gaw Metropolitan France hte the United Kingdom pawng da ai daram re.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turkey mungdan hpe panglai masum gaw shinggrup tawn ai: sinna maga de gaw Aegean panglai, ding dung maga de gaw Panglai Chyang hte dingda maga de gaw Hkarang panglai ni rai nga ai.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxembourg gaw grai galu ai ahtik labau lu ai rai timung shi a shang lawt lu ai nhtoi hpang ai gaw shaning 1839 kaw na she re.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Belgium na ya aten ni gaw Luxembourg na moi na aten ni re raitim Belgian gaw shaning 1830 Belgian Revolution hpang byin wa ai re.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxembourg gaw galoi mung ka-ang ai mungdan langai hku nga shakut ai, raitim Mungkan Majan I hte Mungkan Majan II hta gaw Germany ni shi hpe aup hkang wa sai.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Shaning 1957 hta Luxembourg gaw dai ni Uropa Munghpawm ngu mying ai uhpung uhpawng a gaw sharawt hpung malawm byin wa sai re.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong gaw hten mat sai numhkap dap ba hte Paro ginwang a ntsa daw kaw na Budha hpungki jawng gaw (Phondey mare kaw) re nga ai.
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Dai gaw shaning 1649 hta, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel gaw Tibentan-Mongol ni hpe dang wa ai hpe bai myit dum na matu dai dap hpe galaw wa ai re.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Shaning 1951 kaw gaw, wan gaw Drukgyal Dzong a sali wunli nkau myi sha, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal a sumla jawn re ai ni hpe sha ngam mat hkra galaw lai wa sai.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Wan hkru katut ai hpang dai ninghkap dap ba hpe Bhutan a labau shang ai myit agang shara langai rai wa hkra atsawm sha kyem zing makawp maga da ma ai.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: 18th century hta Cambodia gaw mungdan kaba lahkang Thailand hte Vietnam lapran kaw na shi hkrai shapru wa ai.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Thai masha ni gaw tsa ban 18 hta Cambodia mungdan hpe hpyen n-gun hte grai lang shang gasat wa sai, 1772 ning hta Phnom Phen hpe jahten kau ma sai.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Tsa ban 18 jahtum na shaning ni hta Vietnam gaw Cambodia de hpyen n-gun hte shang gasat ai.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Venezuelan a tsa lam shadang shi matsat gaw bungli nnga ma ai, dai kaw na malawng gaw tara nshang ai bungli dabang hkan bungli shang ma ai.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Venezuela masha yawng kaw na law malawng gaw lajang ya ai bungli hta galaw ma ai, nkau mi gaw rai ni shapraw ai kaw galaw ma ai ngut nna kaang hkup gaw hkai lau hkai sha bungli hta galaw ma ai.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Venezuela masha ni a ahkyak ai jak rung langai gaw sau shapraw ai re, sau jak rung gaw tsa lam shadang langai sha nga tim mungdan jashang gunrai ni hta na grau ai mungdan shapraw gunrai re.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Mungdan shang lawt lu ai a shawng daw de, Singapore hpun kawa hpaji hte seng ai nam pan sun a kungkyang ai ni gaw dai zinlawng hpe kahtet ai nam pan sun mare de galai shai lu wa hkra garum ya lai wa sai re.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Shaning 1981 hta Vanda Miss Joaquim, hpan kayau wa madai pan hpe mungdan a myu sha nam pan hku lata masat da sai.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Hpun lap sha dusat wan 1.5 ram gaw shaning shagu marang ra ai majaw dingdung kawng mayan kaw na Mara Hka nu lai di nna dingda pa layang de hkawm sa ma ai.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Dai hpang sinna maga hpe laidi nna dingdung maga bai wa ai shaloi, kalang bai Mara hka nu hpe shata man mali shata hkan na marang tawng ai hpang bai rap lai ra na re.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Serengeti ginwang kaw Tanzania na Maswa Ginsup Ginra, Ngorongoro Gawn hkang Ginra hte Seregeti Myusha Nampan sun hte Kenya kaw Maasai Mara Myusha Ginra ni lawm ai.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Hti htang akyu jaw ai shi ga dap hpe shalat shapraw na matu hka ja la ai lam hta htung lai hkan ai hte htung hking hte seng ai hpaji kunglet ai lam, hti htang akyu jaw ai lam hte seng ai jawng gawk kata na hkingrai ni hpe kung kyang ai lam (sumla ni hte seng ai lam hpe zinlum ai lam, nsen hte sumla hkrung hpe jep shagrin ai lam hte mau mwi tsun ai lam) ni hpe ra ahkyak nga ai.
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Nang media shapraw ai lam hpe nang maram masam da ai lam hpe nang bai jep maram na hte dingyang lam hku nre ai baw myit na matu kahti galai shalat maka gaw ra nga ai.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Hti htang akyu jaw ai shalat maka ni gaw masing ni hpe langai hte langai matut mahkai na matu dawchyen ni ra nga ai raitimung garan ai hku kri namta ni zawn mung akyu pru nga ai.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Sumla ni hkra, tsan hkra galaw ya ai jan nhpai ni a nkaja ai akyu gaw maju jung yak ai lam, jan nhpai law law ra ai lam ni rai nga ai.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Man balu galaw ai lam hta awngdan tsaw ai hte maren dai kaw manghkang ni yawm wa ai.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Ndai gaw ka'ang galu masat da ai pat nhpai hte rau ningja rawng shadawn la mai ai sumla ni hpe shapraw lu na matu zoom pat nhpai ni bang da ai.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Laga grau kaba mai ai rai na nkaja ai lam gaw kaba dik (lawan) ai rai gaw nkaja ai re.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Ndai lam ni gaw manu hkyem sa ai sumla ni tsan galaw ai pat ni hpe nsin shau ai masa hta kemara kaprip wan nlawm ai sha lang na matu yak shangun ai re.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Sumla hkrung langai hpe DVD hkrang de galai na matu shakut ai shaloi, law malawng madung re ai manghkang langai mi gaw, kompyuta hte sumla dem shakap shalai mat ai lam rai nga ai.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: TV lamang law malawng gaw yu maya masha ni hpe shapyaw na matu sha lajang da ai.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Dai madi madun ai a matu, nang TV kaw mu ai lam yawng gaw shi shingwang kata rep, lahta, npu, maga ga de ni sha re.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Pat man ting hta dai sumla atsawm mu na matu ndai hpe shateng galaw da ai. Dai hpe scan lai ai nga ma ai.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Gam nkaja ai hku, nang DVD galaw ai shaloi, shi a makau ndung ni hpe di kau na zawn re nga ai hte lama na sumla hkrung kaw laika madun ai shaloi npu de grai kap taw nna shanhte hpe yawng nmai madun na ra ai.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Htung hking hte seng ai ka-ang prat na lang gyi ni kaw myit n-gun lu na myit nshat, marai lahkawng gumra jawn let gasat hkat ai, hkik hkam ai lu sha lamang ni hte Hkaw Hkam Arthur a share shagan ai lam hpe shingran pra mu lu hkra galaw da ai lam ni law law nga nga ai.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Moi shaning hking hku kaw na chyahten re ni lapran kaw tsap taw yang moi na hpyen kasat wa ai ntsen hte shingran ni hpe bai lu na re, nlung lam kaw lam hkawm ai zawn ntsen ni ngut nna ga hku kaw na pru wa ai shingran zawn re ni pi lu wa na daram re.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Raitim, anhte a myit ai lam ni gaw ta tut mabyin hta mahta ai re kun? Langchyi ni hpe hpa rai nambat langai shara hta gaw gap lai wa ai kun? Shanhte gara hku shalat maka ni galaw nna gaw gap ma ai kun?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Kaja aten hta, Kirby Muxloe Castle gaw castle majing ni hta pi grau hkrak ai re.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Dai a kaba ai pat hku hte hpa ai bunghku gaw atsawm myit shatawng gasat ai hpe na na hkam jan lu na nre.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: 1480 ning hta, ndai gaw sharawt lam hpe Lord Hastings wa e woi galaw hpang wa ai shaloi gaw ndai mungdan kaw gaw simsa lam nga wa nna shim lum lam a matu gaw ajawt hkawm nna sa hkawm ai masha uhpung kaji ni hpe dinghkap gasat ra lai wa ai re.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Daru magam rap ra lam ngu ai gaw Uropa mungdan ni yawng a awmdawm daru magam lu na matu jai lang ai lai ladat rai nga ai.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Ndai lai ladat a ningmu gaw Uropa mungdan yawng hta na mungdan langai ngai n-gun ja, shingkang shingwang lu wa na hpe tau hkrau makawp maga nhtawm, mungdan Asuya ni hku nna yawng rap rap ra ra byin tai na matu tinang mungdan a jinghku mungdan hpe loi hkring hkring galai na hku rai nga ai.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Spain a Majan dang hkring htawng dagraw ai lam gaw shawng nna majan hta gin jaw a masing re ai ahkang aya shingdaw shangang ai lam hpe masat da sai.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: European ngun ni gaw dai makam masham majan a nkaja ai lam ni nga ai zawn dai gaw ahkyak ai langai rai wa sai. Dai majaw, shaning sumshi majan gaw makam masham majan a hpang chyhtum rai wa sai re.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Ephesus kaw na Artemis nawku jawng gaw shata ma hkru 21 ya, 356 BCE hta Herostratus e galaw shut hpyit lai wa ai wan nat ai amu kaw jahten jaza hkrum lai wa sai re.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Dai mau mwi hku tsun ga nga yang, shi myit rawt ai lam gaw kaja nan mying gumhkawng lai wa sai. Ephesians gaw maroi nni ai hte Herostratus ngu ai mying hpe galoi nna yu ai nga ndau dat ai.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Greek labau ka sara Strabo gaw hpang e mying ni hpe matsing da lai wa sai, dai gaw ndai prat hta anhte gara hku na chye la lu lam rai nga ai. Nawku jawng gaw Alexender the Great shangai ai shana kaw sha jahten shabyak kau ai hkrum lai wa sai.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander gaw hkawhkam langai hku na nawku htingnu gaw gap na ga gumhpraw jaw na matu tsun ai raitimung shi tsun ai ni hpe ningdang kau ya ma ai. Dai hpang, Alexander si mat ai hpang, shaning 323 BCE kaw nawku htingnu hpe bai gaw gap lai wa sai re.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Nang na lata hpe yungwi nsi note ni yawng hpe jaw hkra dum ai shaloi mai byin ai daram shayawm da na matu sadi u. bai nna nang na lata layung ni hpe tingtawk nseng n-ang ai hkam sha lam ni nlaw na matu mung shakut u.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Ndai ladat gaw, na hkum nang gau ngwi gau gwi hki ba shangun na re. Piano kaw nsen shaja na matu ja ja dip ra ai zawn gaw Jaw hpe n-gun law law hte ndip ra ai hpe dum u.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Accordion madum sumpyi hta nsen shaja na matu bellow ni hpe n-gun grau shadat nna (sh) grau lawan ai hku pat let dum ra ai.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Wenyi masa gaw poi daw sha ai lam hkan galaw ai, teng sha Karai a hpung shingkang, wenyi lam ni hpe ta tut hkan sa ai lam rai nga ai.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Kam sham ai ni gaw Nat (sh) nat shayi ni a mau na zawn re ai shingra tara ni hpe tatuk hkrum kadut na matu, chye chyang ai lam lu na matu (sh) myithtoi nyan lu na matu sawk tam ma ai.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Nampan ni gaw lai nli re ai kan bau lam hpe hkan shachyut ai (sh) shaman ai a madung gaw dai mahkrun madup ni hpe bau maka na matu re.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Wenyi masa hpe gaw laga nawku htung hte seng ai makam hpan ni hte laklai re ai mabyin masa hpe dingtawk re ai tingkyen mahkrum madup a machye machyang hte alak myi re nna ngwi pyaw sim sa ai, myi htoi nyan lu ai lam, grai kabu pyaw ai lam kajawng kaja atsam n-gun lu wa ai laklai kumla zawn pyi re ai ni hpe nawku daw jau ai lam hpan ni kaw na mai garan ginghka la mai nga ai.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikhs htung gaw Kala dan daw na makam masham langai re. Dai gaw tsa ban 15th laman Hindu htung hking kata uhpung garan mat ai kaw na Punjab ginra kaw na madung pru wa ai re.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Sikhs gaw Hindu makam hkring htawng hpe hkam la da tim Hindu htung hking kaw na nbung ai makam masham hpung langai ngu sa ai.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Sikhs ni gaw shanhte a nawku hpung hpe Punjabi na "hpung sara ni a lam" re nga ai Gurmat ngu shaga tsun ma ai. Hindu, Sikh hung sara ni gaw India nawku hpung ni yawng a rudi npawt dawsang rai nga ai raitimung Sikh nawku hpung kaw gaw Sikh makam masham a grai ahkyak ai hkrang kumla pru na matu la kau ai rai ma ai.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Dai nawku htung hpe Guru Nanak (1469-1539) hku na tsaban 15th hta mu tam wa ai. Dai hpang sikt hpung sara jahku mung awng dang ai hpang bai hkan nang wa ma ai.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: 1956 Jun shata hta, Krushchev a ga sadi ni gaw Poland hta kasu kabrawng byin ai ten tsun ai galaw ai kun ngu hpe la yu ra ai ten re wa sai. Dai lam gaw bungli galaw ai ni gaw lusha taw wa ai ten, bungli shabrai njaw ai ten, Kummyunit lailen hpe ninghkap ai de gale wa ai ten re.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Cell nga hpa ta? Dai cell nga gaw Latin ga kaw na gawk kasha ngu ai cella kaw na sa wa ai re, dai hpe shawng nnan microscopist hte palin matsun hpe jep yu ai kaw na hpang wa ai re.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Ru hka amu hte law malawng hku nna maigan masha ni hpe nju ndawng ai myit ni gaw Greenland kaw nau nmu lu ai daram re ai. Mare nhtawng ni hkan e mung laja lana re ai gin ra ni mung n-nga ai re.
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Dai shara gaw hkyen ni hte hkyen hka lwi hkang ni hte chyu hpring chyat nga nna dawnghkawn hte masat tawn da ai. Dai kaw gaw hpang kaw sau ni gunrai ni htaw na matu leng matut da ai baw hte laksan galaw shapraw da madaw jak ni rau sha mai hkawm sa nga ai.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Bunghpoi laru gaw nbung na kata de ntsa de na grup yin ma hkra hpe chyup la nna dip n-gun grai nem ai nbung gayin shadawn langai re.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Shanhte gaw nbungl grai gawut ai (ayang 100-200 miles/hking) ngut nna rai kaba hpe pi hpai mat ai, magoi ladi nbung laru hkawm ai hta hpai mat ai.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Tingkyeng hte seng ai VPN (Kompyuta matsun hte nga ai dinghkrai kompyuta hkridun) galaw shapraw ya ai ni gaw mung masa jep joi ai lam hte hpaga IP-geofiltering lahkawng yan hpe kaja htum ai hku koi yen ai ladat re.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Shiga dap ni gaw "masha ni a laksan shiga lamang ni hpe makawp maga na matu" ngu nna tsun let galoi mung masu nga ai.
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".
